messages:
Maria Nunez: Heads up, egress firewall tighten rolled to eu-west ~1h ago. Audit-log buffering spiked and several GPU warmpool node joins failed to prewarm (stuck provisioning). Seeing S3 put throttle errors from the logshipper. @Ajay can you look?
Ajay Patel: Looking. I see 503s from log-collector -> s3 proxy and high conntrack on the NATGW. The firewall added a default-deny for outbound to audit cluster; we allowed the collector LB but the proxy sits on a different ENI.
Devon Chen: From runtime: 8 join attempts timed out waiting for audit ack in last 15m. Warmpool evicted after 2m causing cold starts. First-token latency +120ms p50 for warmups.
Maria Nunez: Cost hit if this goes on — @Ethan any rough numbers?
Ethan Cole: If eu-west warmpool efficiency is degraded for 24h, estimate ~18% extra GPU hours and ~22% token-cost bump for affected routes. S3 retries add a few hundred USD.
Lucy Park: Security rationale: we tightened an overly-broad egress allow to clamp a /22. If we open an exception for the proxy ENI, we must capture it in the audit allowlist with a short-lived justification.
Ajay Patel: I'll add a temporary egress allow for ENI eni-0a1b2c3d and whitelist the proxy CIDR for 1h to let backlog drain. Also bump conntrack on natgw.
Devon Chen: Please flip the warmpool prewarm timeout from 10s -> 60s for eu-west so we don't evict prematurely.
sre-bot: [alert] eu-west: warmpool prewarm failures +9x since firewall rollout. Runbook #wg-boot-02 triggered.
Ajay Patel: Commands I'm running:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-auditshipper --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.12.34.0/24 --description "temp allow log-proxy eni"
# bump conntrack: altering NATGW conntrack settings via infra console
```
Maria Nunez: After Ajay's change logs are trickling, backlog present. How to avoid this class of outages?
Lucy Park: We need a per-region dependency manifest for audit endpoints and gate firewall rollouts with an e2e check validating logshipper->S3 and proxy health. Rollouts should auto-rollback on failure.
Devon Chen: Add a CD test that posts a small event to the audit stream and waits for the S3 object (signed URL) within 30s. Mark deploy failed if it doesn't appear.
Ethan Cole: Also make warmpool degrade path cheaper: prefer slightly reduced capacity over many cold starts and retries. Budgeted fallback ramp could save costs.
Maria Nunez: Actions: 1) let backlog drain (Ajay) 2) revert firewall in eu-west and re-roll with manifest + e2e check (Lucy) 3) tune warmpool fallback (Devon) 4) estimate cost impact and notify finance (Ethan).
Ajay Patel: Backlog draining, errors down to single digits. Temp rule will stay ~45m then we close it. Posting updates.
Devon Chen: Pushed lenient prewarm. Adding per-region metric for audit-ack latency to alert before eviction threshold.
sre-bot: [info] Firewall temp rule added: sg-auditshipper -> allow 10.12.34.0/24:443.
deploy-bot: Rollout event: egress-tighten-v2 -> eu-west FAILED health-check; automatic pause engaged.
Maria Nunez: Good catch. Please @channel update when firewall fully rolled back. :thumbsup:
